questions.question: What 3D shape is a ball?
questions.explain: A ball is a sphere because it is round all the way around. A circle is a flat 2D shape, but a sphere is a 3D object you can hold.

questions.question: A dice is what 3D shape?
questions.explain: A dice is a cube because it is a 3D object with flat sides. A square is just a flat 2D shape, not a 3D object you can pick up.

questions.question: A party hat is what 3D shape?
questions.explain: A party hat is a cone because it has a round bottom and comes to a point at the top. A triangle is a flat 2D shape.

questions.question: A juice can is what 3D shape?
questions.explain: A juice can is a cylinder because it is round and the same width from top to bottom. A circle is a flat 2D shape, not a 3D object.

questions.question: Dad cuts a piece of cheese into a party-hat shape. What 3D shape is it?
questions.explain: A shape with a round bottom that comes to a point is a cone. A triangle is flat, but a cone is a 3D object you can hold.

questions.question: Ben puts 2 balls and 3 dice in a box. How many shapes in the box are cubes?
questions.explain: A dice is a cube, so 3 dice means 3 cubes. The balls are spheres, not cubes, so you do not count them.

questions.question: A shop has 5 shapes: a ball, two juice cans, a party hat, and a dice. How many of them are cylinders?
questions.explain: Two juice cans are cylinders. The ball is a sphere, the hat is a cone, and the dice is a cube, so only 2 are cylinders.

questions.question: Maya says, A dice is a square. What is her mistake?
options: She mixed up which shapes roll and slide.
She said a 3D name for a 2D shape.
She counted the sides of the dice wrong.
She used a 2D name for a 3D shape.
questions.explain: A dice is a 3D object called a cube. Maya called it a square, which is a flat 2D shape, so she mixed up 2D and 3D names.

questions.question: Ana has 4 shapes in a box: a ball, a juice can, a party hat, and a dice. She takes out the one that is a cone. Which shape did she take out?
questions.explain: A party hat is a cone, so Ana took out the hat. The ball is a sphere, the can is a cylinder, and the dice is a cube.

questions.question: Mia plays in the garden and finds a marble next to a daisy. The marble is a what?
questions.explain: A marble is round all the way around, so it is a sphere. A circle is flat, like a sticker, not a 3D shape.

questions.question: Zoe makes a collage with a soup can and a traffic-cone toy. The soup can is a what?
questions.explain: A soup can has two flat round ends and a curved side, so it is a cylinder. A rectangle is a flat 2D shape.

questions.question: Ben picks up a rubber ball and a wizard hat at the toy store. The wizard hat is a what?
questions.explain: A wizard hat is wide at the bottom and pointed at the top, so it is a cone. A circle is flat, like a plate, not a 3D shape.
